evidence: skills/platform-observability/references/alerting-and-on-call.md:5-11 already requires the expected failure, threshold or forecast evidence, concrete action and responsible owner for capacity and impending-failure alerts. A high internal metric alone is not a reason to page; healthy, failure and recovery cases are required.

skills/platform-observability/SKILL.md R7 retains the prohibition on P0 paging without a runbook. Google SRE's Monitoring Distributed Systems treats impending saturation and actionable imminent failure as valid alerting inputs alongside user symptoms; raw diagnostic values alone are insufficient.

Forecast quality and the truth of threshold evidence are not mechanically proved by either the prior SLI-only sentence or the current guidance. The source already imposes the proposed evidence and owner requirements, so duplicating them inline would not supply an additional mechanical guarantee.
